input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The new minimum wait defaults to one second instead of zero.
- failure path: With default options, an early exponential result below one second is raised to a one-second delay, slowing retries that previously had no configured floor.

Reviewer finding
- description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1, not 0. Existing callers who don't pass `min` now get a floor of 1 second on every wait.
- rationale: Trigger: `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, jitter=0)` or any config whose computed wait is below 1s. Line 273 clamps the result up to `self.min`=1, so waits become 1s instead of the configured sub-second values. This silently changes behavior for existing users, and a default of 0 would preserve the previous behavior.
critique: The finding names the same cause as the label: the new `min` parameter defaults to 1 instead of 0. It also describes the same effect, where computed waits below one second are clamped up to one second and existing callers' retries slow down.
